cause: check_runtime_standard_native_r3.py hard-codes the historical standalone-repository date and revision into every newly generated observation.
impact: A fresh observation can be mislabeled as evidence for an unrelated historical subject, breaking exact subject/currentness binding for Agent or human consumers.
nonClaims: The checked-in historical report is not reclassified merely because it references its historical revision.
The defect is the current generator emitting new measurements under a hard-coded old subject.
acceptance: Derive exact current Git source revision at generation time.
Represent owner subtree identity separately when needed.
Represent generation/observation time separately from historical standard dates.
Fail closed or explicitly mark dirty source state instead of silently claiming a clean historical revision.
